details: Flower shade may change depending on availability.
Some flowers may not be available for same day orders, we will replace it with a different flower for the equal value.
Flower life varies depending on the variety, room temperature and care.
careBox: Keep in a cool indoor spot, away from direct sunlight, heat and direct fan.
Slowly add a little clean water between the stems as needed to keep it moist.
Avoid overwatering, and keep the outer box dry.
Gently remove faded petals and flowers to keep the display looking fresh.
careBouquet: Remove wrapping and trim stems 1-2 cm at an angle.
Place in a clean vase with fresh water.
Keep leaves above the waterline and change water daily.
keep away from direct sunlight, heat and strong airflow.
Gently remove faded flowers and petals.
delivery: Confirm delivery availability and charges with us on WhatsApp.
Rain or high demand may cause delays.
